Guide.title: Your complete guide to adopting a pet 🐾
Guide.subtitle: Everything you need to know — from preparing your home to the first weeks with your new furry family member.
Guide.prepareIntro: Before bringing your new pet home, make sure your space is safe, secure, and welcoming.

checklist.title: Secure all windows and balconies
checklist.desc: Pets are curious explorers. Install mesh or grilles to prevent escapes or falls.

checklist.title: Set up a litter box or toilet area
checklist.desc: Cats need a litter box in a quiet spot. Dogs need a designated outdoor or pad area.

checklist.title: Prepare a quiet room for the first days
checklist.desc: A small, calm space helps your pet adjust without feeling overwhelmed.

checklist.title: Remove toxic plants and hazards
checklist.desc: Common toxic plants include lilies, pothos, and aloe vera. Secure loose wires too.

checklist.title: Stock up on essentials
checklist.desc: Food, water bowls, a carrier, toys, and a bed or resting spot.

checklist.title: Find a vet nearby
checklist.desc: Have a vet lined up before your pet arrives for peace of mind.

Guide.firstDaysIntro: The first few days are crucial. Give your pet time and space to explore and adjust at their own pace.
Guide.phase1Desc: Let your pet explore one room first. Don't force interaction. Place food, water, and bedding in the room.
phase1Tips: Keep it quiet — no loud music or guests
Let them come to you, not the other way
Stay calm and speak in a soft, gentle voice
Guide.phase2Desc: Gradually introduce more of the home. Offer treats, gentle play, and consistent routines.
phase2Tips: Play to build confidence and bonding
Guide.phase3Desc: Most pets begin to show their true personality after 2 weeks. This is when the magic happens! 🐾
phase3Tips: Book first vet visit if not done
Guide.costsIntro: Pet ownership is a long-term commitment. Here's a realistic breakdown to help you plan.
Guide.healthIntro: Regular care keeps your pet happy and prevents costly health issues down the line.
Guide.tip1Desc: Even healthy pets need a yearly wellness visit. Early detection saves lives and costs.
Guide.tip2Desc: Core vaccines vary by species. Keep boosters up to date as recommended by your vet.
Guide.tip3Desc: Regular deworming every 3–6 months. Monthly flea and tick prevention recommended.
Guide.tip4Desc: Prevents unwanted litters and reduces risk of certain cancers and behavioural issues.

privacySections.p: We collect your name, email, phone number, and any details you provide when listing a pet or submitting an adoption application.
We use your information to connect adopters with rescuers, send application updates, and improve the platform.
We only share your contact details with the other party in an adoption (e.g. the rescuer or adopter) once an application is approved.

termsSections.p: FurriHearts is a free platform connecting pet rescuers and adopters in Malaysia. You must be 18+ to list or apply for a pet.
Rescuers are responsible for the accuracy of their listings. FurriHearts does not verify the health or temperament claims in any listing.
Harassment, fraud, or misuse of contact information shared through the platform may result in account suspension.
